name: The Sanctuary of the Broken Seal
description: A crypt beneath the burned chapel of Sainte-Croix, outside Payns. Candle smoke and wet stone.

exits.lockedText: The road south opens when Imbert's ledger is yours.

npcs.name: Gerard de Villiers
lines: We kept the Rule for two hundred years. It did not keep us.
Pray when you can. Kill when you must. Confess to no one; there is no one left to hear it.
Every brother you bring back asks me what you have become. I tell them: what the king made of you.

npcs.name: Eleanor of Troyes
lines: The king's coin, the Church's coin, yours. It all spends the same.
A Templar haggling in a smuggler's cellar. Your Rule would have something to say about that.

npcs.name: Sister Ysabeau
lines: Sit. The wounds I can stitch. The rest you carry yourself.
You smell of smoke and other men's blood. Drink this, and do not tell me where you have been.

npcs.name: Brother Thomas
lines: I saw what they did to the others. I am writing it all down, every name. You will want the list.
You came for me. I do not know whether to thank you for how you did it.

npcs.name: The Hermit
lines: The vault was sealed against men like you. Now there are no other kind left.
Vengeance is a debt too. Ask the king how he likes paying his.

npcs.name: Brother Almoner
lines: Each day the Order asks something of you. Each day it pays, in what it has left.
The pledges are the same for every brother. The endeavours are yours alone.

npcs.name: Guillaume the Herald
lines: The Tarasque comes up the Rhône again. The muster gathers at Tarascon.
Twenty can cross, no more. She has to be fought together.

npcs.name: Mathilde of the Menagerie
lines: Every beast here was bought dear. Bring tokens from the great hunts, and gold, a great deal of gold.
They will follow you anywhere. They will not fight for you. Neither would I.

npcs.name: Master Aubry's apprentice
npcs.role: Shows the way to the forge
lines: The master's moved his anvil downstairs, to its own forge. Through the west door.
